requirements: Optional attached TP/SL for opening ordinary/conditional orders
Review independent trigger terms with basis, comparison and unit
Linked protection must be distinguished from two independent conditional orders
native_testing: Skipped at user request. No device tools, device tests or APK installation. See ../native-verification-pending.md.
ios: Linux has no macOS/Xcode; build and native flows unverified.
implementation: One exit uses OTO; TP plus SL uses OTOCO. Main order supports LIMIT/MARKET and STOP/TAKE_PROFIT conditional types; protection uses fixed-quantity TAKE_PROFIT_MARKET/STOP_MARKET.

Sequential child IDs with USDT_FUTURES security type. Each exit is placed when entry leg 1 is FILLED. With two exits, each fully filled exit cancels its sibling. Partial entry fills are explicitly unprotected until full entry fill.

Decimal net new exposure calculation excludes existing same-direction holdings and offsets an existing opposite one-way position. No new exposure blocks attachment. One-way exits reduceOnly; hedge exits retain LONG/SHORT and omit reduceOnly; no closePosition=true.

Independent exit lot/capability/price/trigger/protection checks, exact trigger-direction references, unavailable Last not replaced by Mark, IOC disallowed for strategy entries. Incompatible reduce-only/entire/trailing/quick scopes blocked.

Additional signed positionRisk recheck before POST verifies original positions, leverage and margin mode. Existing snapshot deadline, identity/configuration checks and send-boundary protection retained.
Same EOA signs position verification, exact strategy POST and original-clientStrategyId/type GET with distinct shared nonces. No ordinary order endpoint is used and no extra wallet is created.
HTTP200 failureCode is inspected, raw failureReason excluded. POST acknowledgement is never evidence of fill or absence. Failed or unknown outcomes use query-only recovery; no repeated POST.
An open query -2013 may fall back to an independently signed same-ID/type history query. History maximum lookback is 90 days. Other read/signature failures remain unresolved.

Query strictly matches parent/leg IDs, complete unique sequence, immutable quantity/price/trigger/policy/position flags and both linkage conditions/actions. Inactive order IDs can be missing/zero, and strategy ID is never treated as ordinary order ID.

Strategy query supplies statuses, not verified executed quantities, balances or remaining positions. Accepted strategies support explicit signed refresh of the same original intent; failed refresh retains query-only recovery.

Attached strategies always require their own confirmation, even if ordinary market confirmation is disabled. Chinese/English review includes independent trigger comparisons, fixed exit quantity and lifecycle limits.

320 width, 1.5 text scaling, landscape, canceled review, refresh preservation, unknown lock, query recovery, and hidden attachment settings excluded from trailing/other orders covered by widget tests.
boundaries: This increment provides attached strategy creation and explicit queries, not in-app editing, whole-strategy cancellation or a cross-session strategy list.
Protection activates only on a fully filled entry, uses fixed new-exposure quantity and is not entire close. Neither partial entry fill nor partial exit fill proves peer cancellation.
Actual exchange activation, trigger execution, peer cancellation, signer authorization and native wallet prompts remain unverified.
Aster enable-trading and proof that the same connected EOA is accepted as API signer remain incomplete.
Chase recovery/ID protocol, ordinary BBO price parameters and Scaled distribution/split/remainder rules remain unresolved.
Subaccounts, funding/withdrawals/transfers, full asset valuation, notifications and durable unresolved-order recovery remain incomplete.
